canonical_title: Covert AR probe and drogue lights

versions.title_at_revision: Covert AR probe and drogue lights
versions.text:
Standard: Covert AR probe and drogue lights conform to SAE ARP4392, Covertness paragraph under the Refueling Probe Lights section. Installed covert AR lighting NRI matches the NVIS friendly NRI requirements in SAE ARP5825, NRI Limits for Refueling Lights paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Verify that the installed covert AR lighting conforms to SAE ARP4392, Covertness paragraph under the Refueling Probe Lights section. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
(2) Ground test: Verify that installed covert AR lighting NRI matches the NVIS friendly NRI requirements in SAE ARP5825 NRI, Limits for Refueling Lights paragraph.
